_comment: Baselines for the branch-safety checker. The expected* values are a recorded observation, not a wish: if the live numbers differ, something was pushed or deleted, and rule G9 says so rather than letting it pass unnoticed. Update these deliberately, in a commit, when a change is intentional.
_baselineNote: origin/staging f53fb55e1229 and 16 remote branches, observed read-only. origin/staging is treated as a live production deploy pointer until the Cloudflare Git-integration owner (blocked fact F2) is established. Worktree baseline: 29 registered, 28 on disk, 1 stale registration, 43 local branches against 16 remote.
